Independently inspect the resolved runtime label data and actual existing HTML/JSON-LD context in both languages.
method.reuse: All current product inputs that existed in the immutable prior snapshots have identical bytes. Reuse their genuine prior full 68-topic prose/code review explicitly; do not substitute this targeted data review for full-body reading.
method.renderedContextLimit: Existing dist files were read for real string/context inspection only. Their HTML digests are retained below; this report does not assert they are a fresh artifact for the changed review-input algorithm, and does not claim browser/deployment/search-task acceptance.
method.parserScope: Supported literal model arrays plus explicit sidebar/article mappings are projected. Remaining variable/function/import/export implementation is fingerprinted, not executed/interpreted by the review parser. No arbitrary-JavaScript semantic-support claim.

activeLocaleMenu.judgement: 实际仅发布English/简体中文。以目标语言自称为切换标签自然，lang/prefix/dir为技术标识，中文网站语言与“选择开发语言”的Rust/Node/Python选择不会混淆。

footer.judgement: “文章/RSS/MIT许可证/GitHub仓库/AI文档索引”分别指列表、订阅源、许可证、源码和机器索引；短标签符合页脚语境，所有权技术术语未误作版权或用户权限。

homeNext.judgement: “从JSON开始/CSV批量制卡/AI辅助生成卡片/与genanki比较”四个动作指向各自已经全文审读的任务。JSON仍为主入口，CSV和AI为补充，比较入口保留；起草、审核、APKG构建边界由目标正文说明。

structuredData.judgement: 已读中英现有HTML的JSON-LD：name/headline/description/articleSection使用已审自然文案，软件名称Anki Forge保持品牌，中文“教程”符合文章类别。Schema类型、属性、locale和URL是协议，不翻译。

navigation.judgement: Guide, Examples and Blog are idiomatic parallel navigation labels. Desktop/mobile actions have the same meanings and point to documentation, previews and the article collection.

activeLocaleMenu.judgement: English and 简体中文 are natural target-language autonyms for the two active locales. The website-language menu is distinct from the Rust/Node/Python SDK choice; locale, prefix and direction values remain technical metadata.

footer.judgement: Articles, RSS, MIT license, GitHub repository and AI documentation index accurately identify the collection, feed, license, source and machine index. Concise noun labels fit footer usage and preserve task scope.

homeNext.judgement: Build from JSON, Convert CSV to Anki, Create cards with AI and Compare with genanki are natural actions supported by their already reviewed destinations. The AI destination explicitly requires source checking and local APKG construction; the label does not promise unchecked automation.

initializerSideEffect.judgement: The new implementation projection includes unprojected initializer logic, and the exact previously accepted const-assignment mutation now changes sourceHash and targetHash. No product file was changed for these probes.
